sensory.aromaNotes: Toasty, savory nutritional-yeast character when dried; used as a flavor and protein powder rather than a fibrous analog
sensory.meatAnalogRationale: Important food and feed single-cell protein and flavoring (torula), but it is a yeast powder, not a fibrous hyphal meat analog.
sensory.preparationContext: Spray-dried or inactivated yeast biomass; also autolysates for savory flavor
sensory.confidenceNotes: Long food-use history as torula / Candida utilis; meat-analog score is low by design.

morphology.fruitingBodyStructure: Unicellular budding yeast; no mushroom fruiting body
morphology.sporeCharacteristics: Asci in the sexual state (Pichia/Cyberlindnera); food form is vegetative yeast
morphology.microscopyNotes: Budding yeast cells; the food organism is the anamorph long known as Candida utilis

nutrition.limitingAminoAcids: Sulfur amino acids (typical of yeast SCP)
nutrition.preparationContext: Dried torula / C. utilis biomass used as food yeast
nutrition.confidenceNotes: Protein in the mid-40s % of dry matter is typical of food yeasts; confirm lot specs.

geographic.habitat: Saprotrophic ascomycete yeast; grown on molasses, wood sugars, or other residual carbon

strains.availabilityNotes: Widely used Candida utilis / C. jadinii type material — verify the current catalog listing.

images.caption: Cyberlindnera jadinii: budding cells (A–B) and cream colonies (C–D)

commercialUse.applicationSummary: Torula / Candida utilis is a longstanding food yeast: savory flavor, inactive nutritional yeast, and feed protein. Relevant as an SCP benchmark next to filamentous mycoprotein.

productionProcess.title: Aerobic yeast fermentation
productionProcess.description: Grown on sugars or lignocellulosic hydrolysates, then inactivated and dried.

commercialUse.confidenceNotes: Established food ingredient; not a fibrous meat analog.

regulatory.notes: Torula / Candida utilis has a long history of use as food yeast and flavoring. Confirm the current listing for a specific strain or autolysate.

altProteinResearch.title: Cyberlindnera jadinii (Candida utilis): a yeast of biotechnological interest for food and feed protein
altProteinResearch.summary: Reviews C. jadinii as a food and feed protein organism and the taxonomic move from Candida utilis.
